posts.description: Cross-posted this to alphaxiv . I read the Gan, Isola 2026 paper on neural thickets. posts.title: Quadratic forms of standard normal variables and estimates of trace
posts.description: I should have known this fact! If you have u ~ N ( 0 , I ) and some matrix A , then E [ u T A u ] = t r a c e ( A ) . The corresponding estimator of the trace is called the Girard–Hutchinson estimator .
